gloss: all day long, throughout the day

definitions.gloss: all day long, throughout the day
definitions.explanation: For the entire duration of a day; from morning to night.

examples.japanese: {一日中|いちにちじゅう}{働|はたら}いた。
{一日中|いちにちじゅう}{雨|あめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{降|ふ}っていた。
{一日中|いちにちじゅう}{家|いえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。

notes:
{一日中|いちにちじゅう} means all day long.

SIMILAR PATTERNS:
- {一年中|いちねんじゅう}: all year round
- {一晩中|ひとばんじゅう}: all night long
- {一週間中|いっしゅうかんじゅう}: all week

The pattern is: [time period] + {中|じゅう} = throughout that period
